text.p: These are the leading stories in the Botswana press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A South African managing the First National Bank in Gaborone allegedly slapped a Motswana customer across the face for not queuing properly.
- Botswana is expecting a poor harvest in spite of good rains. The Ministry of Agriculture has attributed this to the governemnt stopping its drought relief programmes.
- HIV patient France Kgakishi has cautioned other sufferers not to waste money on "cures" offered by traditional doctors.
